verses.en: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.sm: Siona nai le tafeaga, ona tusa ai lea o i tatou ma tagata ua fai a latou miti.

verses.en: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.sm: Ona tumu ai lea o tatou gutu i le featani, ma o tatou laulaufaiva i le leo fiafia; ona latou faapea ane lea i nuu ese, Ua faia e le ALII mea tetele mo i latou.

verses.en: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.sm: Ua faia e le ALII mea tetele mo i tatou; ua tatou fiafia ai.

verses.en: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
verses.sm: Le Aw e, ia e faafoisia mai la matou tafeaga, faapei o vaitafe i le itu i toga.

verses.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.sm: O e lulu saito ma loimata, latou te seleseleina

verses.en: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.sm: ma le alaga fiafia. O le ua alu atu ma tagi fano, o loo ave le saito e lulu, e foi mai lava ia ma le alaga fiafia, o loo au mai ana fusi saito.
